description.value: Salmon n' Bannock is Vancouver's only Indigenous restaurant, founded in 2010 and now owned by Inez Cook of the Nuxalk Nation. The kitchen sources wild BC seafood and organic free-range game meats alongside traditional ingredients like bannock and Anishnaabe wild rice to craft modern dishes rooted in First Nations culinary heritage. It sits on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh Nations on the West Broadway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant is actively open for dine-in service and also offers takeout ('Take Away and Uber Eats'). The menu explicitly labels vegetarian ('v') and gluten-free ('gf') items throughout. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Business has a second location at YVR (Vancouver International Airport, post-security near gate 71) — this OSM record and listing cover the Broadway location only.
Website contact page shows full address as '7-1128 West Broadway, Vancouver B.C. Canada V6H 1G5'; OSM addr:unit=7 is consistent but the postal code V6H 1G5 is sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, distinctive Indigenous restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor; a memorable dining stop that touring cyclists would seek out. Required cycling-specific criteria should be confirmed on a follow-up site visit.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels vegetarian dishes '(v)' (e.g., 3 Sisters and a Cuzzin Stuffed Pepper, Rotating Vegetarian Indigenized Risotto) and gluten-free items '(gf)' including Gluten Free Bannock and multiple mains
